{{Quote|The woman—the ''Noorian''—almost ''killed'' one of my men yesterday.|[[Dairoki]], on Tahl|<ref name="Dark Side 3" />}}
'''Noorians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Dark Side 3" /> from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Noori]]. They had dark skin and striped [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A known member was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tahl]], who was a friend of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />
